definitions.explanation: A publication issued separately from a main series, such as a special edition of a magazine or an appendix published as its own volume.

examples.japanese: {別冊|べっさつ}⟦{付録|ふろく}→付録：06206_furoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{付|つ}いている→付く：01960_tsuku⟧。
examples.english: It comes with a separate supplement.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{雑誌|ざっし}→雑誌：00686_zasshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{別冊|べっさつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来月|らいげつ}→来月：00744_raigetsu⟧⟦{発売|はつばい}→発売：04315_hatsubai⟧⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A special issue of this magazine will be released next month.

examples.japanese: ⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦レシピ→レシピ：07157_reshipi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦まとめた→まとめる：02424_matomeru⟧{別冊|べっさつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦{雑誌|ざっし}→雑誌：00686_zasshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{付録|ふろく}→付録：06206_furoku⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{配布|はいふ}→配布：14410_haifu⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A separate volume compiling cooking recipes was distributed as a supplement to a popular magazine.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound of ⟦{別|べつ}→別：01216_betsu⟧ (separate) + ⟦{冊|さつ}→〜冊：00666_satsu⟧ (volume, book). Used in publishing to refer to supplementary or special publications issued alongside a main series.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {別冊|べっさつ}⟦{付録|ふろく}→付録：06206_furoku⟧ (separate supplement)
- {別冊|べっさつ}○○ (Bessatsu + magazine name, e.g., {別冊|べっさつ}マーガレット)
- {別冊|べっさつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧ (to publish a special issue)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{増刊|ぞうかん}→増刊：24084_zoukan⟧: extra issue — a special additional issue of a periodical
- ⟦{付録|ふろく}→付録：06206_furoku⟧: appendix, supplement — an extra item bundled with a publication
